Mandara Spa is the centerpiece for relaxation here, offering Balinese-inspired treatments like hot stone massages and aromatherapy that really help you reset. They have a beautiful relaxation lounge, steam room, and sauna that are open until 8:00 PM daily.

If you are looking for something a bit more low-key for this evening, our heated indoor pool and hot tub are open until 10:00 PM and tend to be quite peaceful. Pro tip: if you book a treatment at Mandara, I'd suggest arriving early to spend time in the lounge first, as it's one of the quietest spots on the entire property. 

Since you're looking to unwind, many guests find that a quiet dinner at Todd English's Tuscany is a great way to follow up a spa visit—would you prefer a full-service spa experience or just some time to lounge by the water?
